goal: Den temporären Browserentwurf um genau einen Remove-Slice erweitern: platzierte Komponente entfernen, monotone Draft-ID-Vergabe und Fokus zur ursprünglichen Zielspalte zurückgeben; weiterhin ohne Persistenz.

guide_delta.summary: Nur der flüchtige Browserentwurf erhält Entfernen und Fokus-Rückgabe. Speichern, Datenbank und persistente Template-Semantik bleiben ausgeschlossen.

tests_required: targeted browser-shell compile and regression tests
remove changes only draftElements browser state
draft IDs remain monotone and are not reused after removal
focus returns to the removed element's original placement target
removing last element restores empty canvas and preview state
GET-only and loopback-only contracts remain unchanged
no persistence, network-write, database or store dependency
tests_explicitly_not_run: full suite because the slice is isolated to the browser mask-builder shell
database regressions because no database path changes
template-store tests because persistence remains out of scope
risks: focus restoration must remain deterministic after DOM re-render
draft ID generation must not derive from current list length after removals
diff churn must remain minimal after the abandoned first I101 attempt
non_changes: no database, repository, CatalogService, writer or SQL access
expected_side_effects: a placed temporary component can be removed before page reload
keyboard focus returns to the corresponding placement target
draft identifiers remain stable and non-reused within the browser session
